pages.title: Pizza Maker
pages.creator: abcgames
pages.description: Pizza Maker takes you through preparing, baking, decorating, and eating a pizza. Choose themes such as Italian, unicorn, candy, or pirates, then use different toppings to give the pizza its own look. Animated cooking scenes show the stages of the process, with left mouse clicks used to play.

pages.title: Good to drive
pages.creator: K.games.
pages.description: Good to drive is a transport puzzle in which each level calls for the right kind of vehicle. Examine the route, select a suitable form of transport, and guide it through the stage. The required choice changes between levels, making vehicle selection part of solving each driving challenge.

pages.title: Bloxorz - Block Puzzle 3d
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Bloxorz - Block Puzzle 3d asks you to roll a block across three-dimensional platforms and drop it into a goal hole. Work out the route and the block's orientation so it reaches the opening in the right position. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move through the puzzles.

pages.title: Guns vs Magic
pages.creator: SMOKOKO LTD
pages.description: Guns vs Magic follows Silvius, a magic student confronting his former mentor Lucius. A cursed crystal has turned the wizard into a threat to the world. Fight Lucius's enchanted creatures and work toward facing the sorcerer himself as Silvius tries to stop the dark powers his mentor has unleashed.

pages.title: Snow Rider Obby Parkour
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Snow Rider Obby Parkour offers snowboarding challenges for one player or two in split-screen play. Race down mountains, explore an open world, or work toward a distance record across its different modes. Double jumps help with movement, and unlockable equipment changes the character's appearance. Player one uses WASD and Space; player two uses the arrow keys and K to jump.

pages.title: English Checkers
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: English Checkers lets you play against the computer, an online opponent, or another player on the same screen. Ordinary pieces move one diagonal square forward, while kings can also move backward. Jump over an adjacent enemy piece when the space beyond it is empty. Captures are compulsory, and further available jumps continue within the same turn.

pages.title: Tangle Master 3D
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Tangle Master 3D is a rope-untangling puzzle. Work through the twisted ropes and resolve their knots to solve each arrangement. Tap to interact with the puzzle and plan how to separate the tangled strands.

pages.title: Feed the Parrot
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Feed the Parrot turns fruit tiles into a matching puzzle. Gather three tiles showing the same fruit in the glass to clear a set, working toward clearing the board and opening new levels. Keep room for future selections: filling the glass completely ends the attempt.

pages.title: Collect Em All
pages.creator: VOODOO
pages.description: Collect Em All asks you to swipe through neighboring blocks of the same color. Build chains to clear them and meet the level's objective within a limited number of moves. Your path cannot cross back over itself. Longer combinations can unlock clearing or shuffling power-ups, and especially strong chains award extra moves.

pages.title: Perfect Piano Magic
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Perfect Piano Magic combines music timing with shooting blocks. Click or tap the blocks with the gun in time with the beat, following the rhythm as the game continues. Each attempt gives you three chances, so accurate timing helps you keep the music challenge going.

pages.title: Javelin Battle
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Javelin Battle is a physics-based spear-throwing game with stickman enemies. Eliminate the incoming opponents to clear a Normal Mode level, aiming at infantry and spearmen on platforms. Breaking an infantry soldier's shield makes that enemy rush toward you. Select skills to improve your abilities and power as you work through the battles.

pages.title: Remove the Evidence
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Remove the Evidence puts you in charge of cleaning up after a clumsy criminal. Tap objects and move them to deal with the mess before the authorities arrive. Each puzzle revolves around removing the traces left behind and putting the chaotic scene in order.

pages.title: Best Friends Puzzle
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Best Friends Puzzle pairs color-linking puzzles with battles against forest birds. Connect at least three symbols of one color to support the Bug Heroes and activate their perks. Longer chains help complete the levels and defeat enemies. Gather experience bottles and upgrade the heroes to strengthen their abilities.

pages.title: Lulus Fashion World
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Lulus Fashion World lets you create outfits for different occasions while progressing through cities and events. Choose clothing and makeup from the items you own, style a look, and save outfits for later use. Collect stars as you take on the fashion challenges and develop your own collection of designs.

pages.title: 2 Cars Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: 2 Cars Run is a dual-car obstacle challenge. Keep track of both vehicles and guide them clear of hazards, dividing your attention between the two routes. A safe move for one car still leaves the other to watch, making coordination central to the run.

pages.title: Art Puzzle Master
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Art Puzzle Master asks you to rebuild artworks from jumbled pieces. Examine the image fragments and rearrange them into a complete picture. Work through the levels as the puzzles become more difficult and the pieces require closer attention to fit together.

pages.title: Mahjong Connect HD
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Mahjong Connect HD is a tile-pairing puzzle in which connections must follow a clear route. Select matching tiles that can be joined by a line with no more than two turns. Other tiles and obstacles cannot block that path. Keep removing available pairs until the entire board is empty.

pages.title: Fitness Girls Dress Up
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Fitness Girls Dress Up lets you assemble sports outfits for a fitness character. Browse workout suits and coordinate a look for activities such as gym training, football, or athletics. Change clothing with mouse clicks and prepare the girl to head to the workout area.

pages.title: Paco Paco
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Paco Paco sends you through mazes to collect the spheres required for each level. Keep away from the ghosts roaming the corridors while gathering enough to progress and aiming for a higher score. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, or touch the screen on mobile.

pages.title: Super Metal Wars
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Super Metal Wars pits warrior robots against each other on dangerous platforms. Pick up weapons that appear in the arena and shoot the opposing robot through a series of five confrontations. Play alone with the arrow keys and L to fire, or add a second player using WASD and F for their robot.

pages.title: Mob Control
pages.creator: VOODOO
pages.description: Mob Control has you fire a stream of people from a cannon to form a crowd. Swipe horizontally to aim toward multiplier gates, increasing the group before it reaches enemy forces and bases. Avoid red gates, push back the red crowd, and work toward capturing all the bases.

pages.title: Pair Up
pages.creator: tiplay studio
pages.description: Pair Up asks you to find matching objects in a crowded pile. Drag and drop two identical items together to make a pair, clearing as much of the room as you can. The scenes use settings such as kitchens, classrooms, gyms, and markets, with the goal of matching the largest number of objects.

pages.title: Paper Fold Origami 2
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Paper Fold Origami 2 is a picture-making puzzle based on folding paper. Tap the paper to fold its sections and assemble the image. Work out how the folds bring the picture together as you move through the puzzles.

pages.title: Monster Rush
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Monster Rush combines an obstacle run with collecting and team battles. Gather Monster Balls along the route to catch creatures and build a fighting team. Take the monsters into the battle arena, power up your force, and face other trainers with the team you have assembled.

pages.title: City Bus Driver
pages.creator: Inspector Studios
pages.description: City Bus Driver puts you in charge of driving a bus between points in a large city. Completing the trips earns rewards that can be saved or spent on customizing the vehicle. Use the arrow keys and mouse to play, developing the bus's appearance and features as you continue driving.

pages.title: Kitchen Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Kitchen Mahjong is a timed tile-matching puzzle. Remove pairs of similar pictures, selecting tiles with an open side on the left or right. Hints can help locate a pair when the board is difficult to read. Clear all the tiles before time runs out; unused time contributes to the bonus.

pages.title: Fun Fishing
pages.creator: Pushin Games
pages.description: Fun Fishing casts you as an underwater hunter using guns to catch fish. Tap a fish to take a shot, remembering that every attempt costs money. Accurate aiming matters when pursuing larger catches. Upgrade the guns to take on bigger fish as you continue hunting beneath the surface.

pages.title: Mr Noob jailbreak
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Mr Noob jailbreak follows a prison escape across rooftops filled with guards. Run as far as possible, jump over dangers, and shoot enemies while trying to improve your score. Slow motion gives you more time to aim. Right-click fires, W jumps, S slides, and Space activates slow motion; touch buttons are also available.

pages.title: Love Cat Line
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Love Cat Line is a drawing puzzle about bringing two cats together. Sketch a horizontal line that helps the pair reach each other, working out where the path should go to reunite them. Use the mouse or touch controls to draw and solve the scene.

pages.title: Ninja Dogs 2
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Ninja Dogs 2 sends a team of canine ninjas after secret scrolls stolen by an evil yellow cat. Aim a cannon by adjusting its angle and power with the mouse, then click to launch a dog. Clicking again during flight activates that dog's special attack. Work through forty-five levels with Master Dog joining the team.

pages.title: Huggy Skate
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Huggy Skate puts Huggy on a skateboard for an obstacle-filled ride. Tell him when to jump and when to stop so he can get past hazards without landing on his head. Press W to jump, including a double jump, and A to stop; mobile play uses touch controls.

pages.title: Drag and Drop Clothing
pages.creator: nau.kids
pages.description: Drag and Drop Clothing is a shape-recognition puzzle using clothes. Look at each item and drag it to the correct place, comparing its shape with the position where it belongs. Matching the clothing to its destination is the main task.

pages.title: Cut and Dunk
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Cut and Dunk turns rope cutting into a basketball puzzle. Swipe across ropes to release the suspended balls, choosing the timing of each cut so they reach the hoop. Put every ball into the basket to score and complete the level.

pages.title: Witch Word:Halloween Puzzel Game
pages.creator: Game Ashlar
pages.description: Witch Word:Halloween Puzzel Game is a Halloween-themed word puzzle. Swipe between letters to form answers and uncover the hidden words. Find all the required words to win, using the left mouse button to connect the letters.

pages.title: TRZ Pool
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: TRZ Pool challenges you to pocket ten balls. Aim with a tap, release, then tap again when the power bar reaches the strength you want. Consecutive successful pots increase your score. Pocketing the cue ball leaves your points intact but breaks the scoring sequence.

pages.title: Belt It
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Belt It asks you to secure cargo boxes inside a truck with colored ropes. Arrange the restraints so the boxes stay contained when the vehicle starts or stops and the load begins to slide. Try solving the transport puzzle with fewer ropes once you understand how the cargo moves.

pages.title: Stick Duel Battle
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Stick Duel Battle is a physics-based stickman fight with weapons and a variety of maps. Play alone or against a second player, adapting to the arena as you try to reach five points first. One player uses the arrow keys and L, while the other uses WASD and F.

pages.title: Stair Run Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Stair Run Online has you gather bricks during a run and spend them to build steps over obstacles. Tap to construct stairs when the route requires them, keeping clear of the red zones. Collect enough bricks to cross the course and climb the mountain at the end for coins.

pages.title: Happy Racing Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Happy Racing Online sends a motorcyclist toward the finish through routes scattered with gold coins. Control the bike's speed and turns to complete each stage and improve your score. Levels can be replayed, and collected coins unlock additional motorcycles with better capabilities.

pages.title: Jumping Dot Colors
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Jumping Dot Colors asks you to keep a ball airborne with clicks or taps. Pass through the sections of each barrier that match the ball's current color, checking its new shade before approaching the next obstacle. Cross as many colored barriers as you can without touching a mismatched section.

pages.title: Stacky Dash
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Stacky Dash has you guide a character across platforms while collecting bricks. Build up enough of the stack to get past the crossings and reach the final platform. You can retrace routes to gather more bricks, helping you cross the gaps and earn more diamonds. Drag to control the character.

pages.title: Find Seven Differences
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Find Seven Differences challenges you to compare pictures across ten levels. Select the details that do not match; each discovery receives a red circle so you can see what is already found. There are no hints, and running out of time means starting again. Incorrect clicks produce a warning, so inspect the pictures before selecting.

pages.title: Zumbo Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Zumbo Mania is a marble-shooting puzzle about stopping a moving chain. Fire marbles to make groups of at least three of the same color, removing them before the chain reaches its endpoint. Tap the frog to exchange the current and next marble, and use power-ups to help clear the board. Each level offers a three-star target.

pages.title: Let's Catch
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Let's Catch is a number-merging puzzle controlled by dragging blocks. Bring blocks with the same number together to merge them, then continue working with the larger values that result. The challenge grows as the numbered blocks become harder to combine.

pages.title: Fruits Scramble
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Fruits Scramble asks you to connect a jumbled word with the fruit it names. Work out the correct order of the letters, then select the matching fruit picture. Use the mouse or touchpad to choose an image once you have identified the scrambled name.

pages.title: Chained Bike Racing 3D
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Chained Bike Racing 3D puts you on a motorbike alongside a paired bike for a series of riding tasks. Manage your speed to avoid heavy impacts with obstacles and get to the destination. Use the arrow keys to control the motorcycle as you work through the racing challenges.

pages.title: Candy Monster Kid
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Candy Monster Kid is a matching game about feeding a hungry monster. Arrange three or more candies in a row so the creature can eat them. Tap to play and keep making candy combinations as you work through the levels.

pages.title: Warzone Getaway 2020
pages.creator: AceViral.com LTD
pages.description: Warzone Getaway 2020 asks you to defend a jeep against repeated waves of attackers. Aim and shoot with the mouse, reload with Space or R, and use Z and X for items. Improve guns and turrets, stock up on grenades, and call for air support. Earning experience unlocks five special attacks for the defense.

pages.title: Space Jumper
pages.creator: Vladimir Lysykh
pages.description: Space Jumper sends an astronaut across asteroids toward a waiting shuttle. Use the mouse to make jumps between the rocks, collecting stars along the way. Guide the astronaut to the spacecraft to complete the journey.

pages.title: Parking Master 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Parking Master 3D turns parking into a route-drawing puzzle. Use the mouse to sketch paths that guide cars into their parking positions. Work out a suitable route for each vehicle and direct it toward the required spot.

pages.title: Moto Beach Jumping Simulator Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Moto Beach Jumping Simulator Game puts a motocross bike on a tropical island filled with stunt ramps. Ride toward the jumps and launch from them to earn points. Try to improve your high score before time runs out, making the most of the beach's large ramps.

pages.title: City Bike Ride
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: City Bike Ride offers two bicycles and three environments for exploring and performing tricks. There are no time limits or assigned objectives, so you can ride wherever you choose. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, Space for a bunnyhop, and X for the rear brake while practicing your stunts.

pages.title: KinderGarten Spot the Differences
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: KinderGarten Spot the Differences presents pairs of pictures that look almost identical. Examine both images and click or tap each small detail that differs. Search through the levels and try to locate the changes as quickly as you can.

pages.title: 2D Car Racing
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: 2D Car Racing is an endless driving game about covering distance and collecting bonuses. Use the mouse to guide the car as the run continues, trying to travel farther and gather the pickups along the route.

pages.title: Impossible Police Car Track 3D 2020
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Impossible Police Car Track 3D 2020 asks you to drive police cars through difficult tracks across more than ten levels. Choose from the available vehicles and work through each course. The Up arrow accelerates, Down brakes, and Left and Right steer, giving you control over the car's speed and position.

pages.title: Motor Yamaha YZF R1 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Motor Yamaha YZF R1 Puzzle offers six pictures of the motorcycle to assemble as jigsaws. Each image has four piece counts: 16, 36, 64, or 100. Choose a picture and difficulty, then use the mouse to fit the pieces together and rebuild the bike image.

pages.title: Roller Magnet 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Roller Magnet 3D has you roll a magnetic ball through a course, gathering cubes and using its force to break apart objects. Keep away from hazards while trying to collect every cube in the level. Use the mouse or arrow keys to guide the ball.

pages.title: Batty The Bat
pages.creator: Pavel Mishin
pages.description: Batty The Bat challenges you to collect pumpkins across twenty-four Halloween levels. Click in different parts of the screen to control Batty's flaps: clicks near the sides send her farther, while clicks closer to her make her rise more. Clicking directly below pushes her upward. Use Space to pause while working out a flight path.

pages.title: Arcade BasketBall
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Arcade BasketBall is a basketball score challenge inspired by arcade machines. Shoot baskets while racing the clock and try to make the most of the available time. The game uses mouse controls.

pages.title: Formula Drag
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Formula Drag is a drifting challenge with four Formula-style racing cars. Use the mouse or touch controls to guide the car and keep it on the track. Maintain your route through the course while trying to improve your result.

pages.title: Flower Girl Dressup
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description: Flower Girl Dressup lets you give Tulisa a flower-themed makeover. Build a look around her love of floral designs, choosing clothing such as patterned tights and ruffled dresses. Use the mouse to style her appearance and finish the outfit with a coordinated flower-inspired look.

pages.title: Find The Pairs
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Find The Pairs is an image-matching puzzle. Look for pictures that belong together and use the mouse to select their matching partners. Recognizing the similar images is the central task as you search for pairs.

pages.title: Tornado.io
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: Tornado.io puts you in control of a destructive tornado. Tap or drag to move it through the surroundings and devour objects along its path. Sweep across the scene and work toward causing as much destruction as possible.

pages.title: EG Motorcyclists
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Motorcyclists has you switch between lanes on a motorcycle while avoiding other riders and holes in the road. Move up or down with mouse clicks, keyboard controls, or touch input to find a clear position. The game gradually speeds up, leaving less time to react to the next hazard.

pages.title: Offroad Trucks Memory
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Offroad Trucks Memory is a matching-picture puzzle with off-road truck images. Choose a level mode, find the matching pictures, and work through the board until every pair is found. Completing all the matches wins the game.

pages.title: Catch Dots
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Catch Dots is a color-matching reaction game with two colored catchers. Tap to switch their arrangement and line up each approaching dot with the matching color. Correct catches add to your score, while a dot meeting the wrong color ends the attempt.

pages.title: Flip The Gun
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Flip The Gun is a timing game about keeping a gun from falling. Make flips at the right moments and collect money as you continue. The cash unlocks more powerful guns, giving you additional weapons to use while trying to keep the flipping run going.

pages.title: Sky Jump
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Sky Jump challenges you to stay on top of platforms for as long as possible. Keep clear of the obstacles while maintaining your position on the platforms and prolonging the attempt.

pages.title: College Love Story
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: College Love Story tells Ethan's story through a messenger-style conversation. Follow the chat as he prepares for a major change in his life and find out what happens at his high school. Simple one-touch interaction moves you through the unfolding story.

pages.title: Stack The Burger
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Stack The Burger challenges you to assemble burgers from ingredients falling through the air. Time the cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion, bacon, and other toppings so they land in the required order. Correctly stacked burgers earn tips, and the shop offers additional toppings and combinations to purchase.

pages.title: Connect The Roads
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Connect The Roads is a road-tile puzzle about giving a car a route to work. Move the tiles to join the road sections into a complete path. Work through twenty-four levels and aim for three stars in each, with an option to show or hide the grid.

pages.title: Empress Creator HTML5
pages.creator: Missangest Games
pages.description: Empress Creator HTML5 lets you design a royal character and the scene around her. Choose a background, arrange her hair, and select regal dresses to build the empress's appearance. Save the completed creation once the character and setting look the way you want.

pages.title: Highschool Day
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Highschool Day lets you dress a couple who want to impress each other at school. Browse the available fashion items and put together an outfit for each character, coordinating their school looks for the day.

pages.title: Highschool Girls House Cleaning
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Highschool Girls House Cleaning puts you in charge of tidying a home shared by school friends. Clean and disinfect the bathroom, then give the bedroom and kitchen the attention they need. Work through the household cleaning tasks to get the rooms in order.

pages.title: Sudoku Classic
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Sudoku Classic asks you to complete a nine-by-nine number grid. Use the existing entries as clues, filling the empty cells while checking the rows, columns, and three-by-three sections for repeated numbers. Work through the remaining spaces until the grid is correctly completed.

pages.title: Monster Mansion
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Monster Mansion is a picture-restoring puzzle featuring jumbled monster scenes. Select two image pieces to exchange their positions and keep rearranging the fragments until the original picture is restored. A hint shows the reference image, and the game tracks the time taken to finish the puzzle.

pages.title: Riders Feat
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Riders Feat is a motorcycle obstacle challenge. Ride up and over the objects along the route while keeping the bike from crashing. Work through each obstacle and control the ride carefully to continue across the course.

pages.title: Princesses Contest
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princesses Contest puts two princesses into a fashion competition. Help prepare both entrants for the evening by choosing their outfits, then see which princess wins once the looks are complete.

pages.title: Princesses PJ Party
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Princesses PJ Party lets you prepare two princesses for a pajama party. Choose sleepwear, try different hairstyles, and finish their looks with fluffy slippers and accessories. Combine the wardrobe items to create a party outfit for each girl.
